preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array must be between 2 and 200,000.
The constant m must be at least 1.
The number of subarrays k must be at least 2.
The product of m and k must not exceed the number of elements n.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array must be between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible sum of the beauties of the subarrays.

postconditions.expression: len(partition) == k - 1 and all(1 <= p <= n - 1 for p in partition)
postconditions.description: The partition must contain k-1 integers, each representing a valid split point.

postconditions.expression: all(partition[i] < partition[i + 1] for i in range(len(partition) - 1))
postconditions.description: The partition points must be in strictly increasing order.
